FN-11I1RZL-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 100
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 100 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama State Board of
Pharmacy until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
